question: Compute the compound interest on ₹ 8,400 for one and half years at 12% rate of interest per annum, compounded half yearly.
solution:
**GIVEN:**

Sum = Rs 8400 (1 +(6)/(100))³

Time = One and a half years

Rate = 12% per annum compounded half early 

**FORMULA USED:**

Compound Interest = P ( 1 + (r)/(100))^n - P where n = time and P = principal or sum 

When it is compounded half-yearly, then time becomes double i.e. = 3 years in this case

and the rate becomes half i.e. 6% in this case.

**CALCULATION:**

Principal = 8400 

C.I. = 8400 ( 1+ (6)/(100))³ - 8400 

⇒ (8400 × 106/100 × 106/100 × 106/100) - 8400 = 1604.5 

**Hence, compound interest is Rs1604.5**
